selected.title: His Mom Knew Our Baby Name Before I Did
selected.hook: My boyfriend’s mother congratulated me on the baby name we had apparently chosen.
selected.voiceover:
My boyfriend’s mother congratulated me on the baby name we had apparently chosen.

We are not expecting a baby.

We were having Sunday lunch with his family when she smiled and said, ‘I still think Eleanor is perfect.’ I laughed because I thought she was teasing us.

Nobody else laughed.

My boyfriend immediately changed the subject, so on the drive home I asked what that was about.

He admitted he had been telling his family we were ‘trying soon.’

That was already strange because we had agreed not to even discuss kids until after I finished my degree next year.

Then I asked about the name.

Apparently, for months, he and his mother had been sending baby names back and forth. She had made a private Pinterest board for nursery ideas. His sister had even offered to save her old crib for us.

I asked why he would involve everyone in a future we had never agreed on.

He said he was just excited and that none of it was real planning.

Then his phone lit up in the cup holder.

His mother had texted: ‘Don’t worry. She’ll come around once it happens.’

That sentence changed the entire conversation.

He swore he had never planned to pressure me, but suddenly all those harmless family chats felt like a decision being built around me.

I told him I needed space, and now his family says I embarrassed him over a hypothetical baby.

Would you see this as overexcited future planning, or a boundary that was already being crossed?
selected.youtube_description:
A family lunch gets awkward when his mother casually mentions the baby name his girlfriend supposedly chose — except she never chose one, and they are not expecting. What follows reveals months of private conversations about children, nursery plans, and a future timeline the couple had never agreed on. Is this harmless excitement about starting a family, or a serious relationship boundary being crossed?
